name: c-stepper-37
title: Stepper with horizontal step cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as clickable icon cards that wrap to 2 columns when narrow, with a corner check on done cards and the step detail below.

"use client" import { useRef, useState } from "react" import { Frame, FramePanel } from "@/components/reui/frame" import { IconTile } from "@/components/reui/icon-tile" import { Stepper, StepperContent, StepperDescription, StepperIndicator, StepperItem, StepperNav, StepperPanel, StepperTitle, StepperTrigger, } from "@/components/reui/stepper" import { cn } from "cn" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const steps = [ { title: "Resolution", detail: "Choose a fix: roll back, scale out or patch forward.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Execute", detail: "Roll api-gateway back to v2.14.1 across 6 pods.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Verify", detail: "Watch error rate and p95 latency for 10 minutes.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Summary", detail: "Record the timeline, root cause and follow-ups.", icon: ( ), }, ] const completed = ( ) export function Pattern() { const [current, setCurrent] = useState(2) const prevRef = useRef(null) const nextRef = useRef(null) // One past the last step marks every step complete. No tab is selected // then, so the last one keeps the tablist's tab stop. const allDone = current > steps.length function goTo(step: number) { setCurrent(step) // The pressed button disables itself at either end, so focus moves to its partner. if (step === 1) nextRef.current?.focus() if (step > steps.length) prevRef.current?.focus() } return ( {/* The frame paints nothing: it only lends each card its per-style radius, padding, border and surface. The default variant, not ghost, so vega and nova cards round at the drawn 10px rather than 11px. */} {/* Two columns below 36rem, where four would cut the titles short. */} {steps.map((item, index) => { const step = index + 1 const done = step < current return ( {/* The card is the tab itself, so all of it takes the click and the focus ring. The radius undoes the trigger's pill. The done tint is a 5% layer over the card's own surface, as drawn: an sRGB color-mix would carry the success color's out-of-gamut red into the result. */} } className="hover:border-ring/60 data-[state=active]:border-ring/50 data-[state=active]:bg-input/20 data-[state=completed]:border-success data-[state=completed]:from-success/5 data-[state=completed]:to-success/5 min-w-0 gap-2 overflow-visible rounded-(--frame-panel-radius) px-2.5 shadow-none data-[state=completed]:bg-linear-to-b" > {/* outline's dark:bg-input/32 would outrank a state class in dark mode, so a done step swaps to the solid variant. Its white edge is drawn outside the fill, hence a ring. */} {item.icon} {/* leading-5 is text-sm's own line height: truncate clips at the line box, so the title's default leading-none would cut the descenders of Verify and Summary. */}
{item.title} Step {step} {done && , completed}
{/* A child of the card so the check takes the click too: half of it lies past the corner arc, where a rounded box takes no pointer hits, hence overflow-visible (min-w-0 keeps the titles truncating). Centered 0.4r in from the edge and 1px above the arc (0.2r down there): 3px out and 6px up at the drawn 10px, less the 1px border the offsets start inside; max() floors the square styles at 0. The stepper's pt-2 keeps the first row's check off any clipping parent, and the item's isolate keeps a focused card's z-10 off the host page. */} ) })} {steps.map((item, index) => (

{item.title}

{item.detail}
